summary: Upgraded the ClientApp from Angular 14.3 to Angular 15.2 with `ng update @angular/core@15 @angular/cli@15`, which pulled TypeScript to 4.9 and ran the v15 CLI and core migrations (platform-server renderModule re-export, Karma require.context removal, ES2022 target with useDefineForClassFields:false, relativeLinkResolution removal). @ngrx/* followed to 15.4.0. Install, build and the SSR build all pass from a clean node_modules; tests still fail exactly as at baseline for the same pre-existing reason.
changes: ng update @angular/core@15 @angular/cli@15 bumped all @angular/* packages to 15.2.10 and @angular/cli / @angular-devkit/build-angular to 15.2.11; TypeScript moved from ~4.6.4 to ~4.9.5, the minimum Angular 15 supports.
CLI v15 migration removed the `renderModule` re-export from src/main.server.ts, since Angular 15 exports it from @angular/platform-server itself; only `renderModuleFactory` stays.

CLI v15 migration removed the `require.context('./', true, /\.spec\.ts$/)` bootstrap and the `declare const require` from src/test.ts. The v15 Karma builder discovers spec files itself, so this is the supported form.

CLI v15 migration set tsconfig.json `target` to ES2022 and added `useDefineForClassFields: false` (matching what the CLI now forces internally), and dropped the now-redundant `target: es2016` override from src/tsconfig.server.json.

Core v15 migration removed `relativeLinkResolution: 'legacy'` from RouterModule.forRoot in src/app/app.module.ts; the option no longer exists in v15 and only `corrected` resolution remains. Dropped the empty options object the migration left behind.
Core v15 RouterLinkWithHref -> RouterLink migration and the CLI browserslist/angular.json cleanups found nothing to change.

Ran ng update @ngrx/store@15, moving all five @ngrx/* packages from 14.3.3 to 15.4.0 so their Angular peer range matches v15; the effects/router-store/store 'road to v15' migrations found nothing to change.
Restored the trailing newline on package.json that the ng update rewrite dropped.
package-lock.json regenerated through npm; verified by deleting node_modules and running a plain `npm install` (no --legacy-peer-deps needed), then `npm run build` and `npm run build:ssr`.
manual_followups: `npm run test` still fails exactly as at baseline: angular.json's test target lists "styles.css" instead of "src/styles.css", so webpack reports a load error and karma aborts before any spec runs. Left untouched to keep this hop to the upgrade; worth fixing on its own, and it will keep hiding real test breakage in every later hop.

src/main.server.ts now exports only `renderModuleFactory`, which is itself deprecated (ViewEngine-era). Combined with the fact that Startup.cs uses UseSpa/UseAngularCliServer and never UseSpaPrerendering, the SSR entry still looks like dead code: consider removing the server target and aspnet-prerendering entirely.
`useDefineForClassFields: false` was added by the migration to preserve current class-field semantics under ES2022. A person should decide whether the app can move to the standard `true` behaviour.

Angular 15 removed the legacy `relativeLinkResolution` behaviour; the router now always uses `corrected` resolution. The routes here are all absolute top-level paths with no relative routerLinks in child routes, so no behaviour change is expected, but a runtime click-through of the nav and the employee edit links is worth doing.
add-employee.component.ts still uses the Untyped* form classes from the v14 opt-out; adopting Angular 15 typed reactive forms is still open.

`npm run lint` is still broken from the v13 hop: the tslint architect targets were deleted and nothing replaced them. The project should move to @angular-eslint and drop tslint/codelyzer from optionalDependencies.
angular.json still carries `defaultConfiguration: ""` on the build and server targets from the v12 migration.
node-sass 4.x still fails to build its native binding on modern Node and is skipped as an optional dependency; it is unused by the build but should be dropped or replaced with `sass`.

core-js is still pinned at ^2.6.5, @types/node at ^12, zone.js at ~0.11.4 and rxjs at ^6.6.7; rxjs 6 in particular is the last version Angular 15 accepts, so the move to rxjs 7 must happen before Angular 16.
